title: Meta Introduces Real-Time Voice Mode for Muse AI
excerpt: Meta has rolled out a new real-time voice conversation feature for its Muse AI agent, complete with an expressive avatar.
body_html: Meta has introduced a new voice mode for its Muse AI agent, allowing users to engage in real-time voice conversations. CEO Mark Zuckerberg announced the update, which includes an expressive avatar displayed at the top of the interface during chats. The feature has been made available on the iOS app.
